title: Nick Fury: Justice Protocol
summary: This Justice build clears schemes with Covert Surveillance, For Justice, and Surveillance Team while Concentrated Fire, Spray Fire, and Stealth Strike handle the damage plan. Helicarrier, Field Agents, and dual-aspect resources keep the economy stable enough to chain SHIELD allies and prep upgrades. Practiced Plan and Informant packages tighten draws so the kit stays online into the late game.
